external_research.title: Interpretability without actionability: mechanistic methods cannot correct language model errors despite near-perfect internal representations
external_research.finding_scope: Reported probe/readout quality can remain very high while tested steering/intervention methods correct only a minority of downstream errors and can disrupt correct behavior.
external_research.project_effect: Strengthens DECODED_OR_SEPARABLE != CAUSALLY_CONTROLLABLE. Trigger-2 J-Space acceptance must include intervention efficacy, rescue/reversibility and off-target damage, not probe/readability alone. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_research.title: A Mechanistic Lens on Semantic Conflicts: Using Activation Patching to Understand LLM Behavior
external_research.finding_scope: Controlled residual-stream activation patching localizes behaviorally relevant states under cue/code semantic conflict in the reported models/tasks.
external_research.project_effect: Supports matched causal patch/lesion/rescue designs for Global J-Space claims and hard negatives where surface semantics conflict with executable/canonical state. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_research.title: Learning the Wrong Lessons: Syntactic-Domain Spurious Correlations in Language Models
external_research.finding_scope: Synthetic training correlations between syntax and domain can reduce semantic task performance and can override intended prompt semantics in reported models.
external_research.project_effect: Strengthens current full-cross/conditional-independence nuisance law for model-visible serialization, order, slot, module-count and bridge-format factors. RANDOMIZATION_ONLY remains insufficient. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

hypothesis: The dominant post-proof training failure risk is shortcut capture: the 0.8B cognitive module can learn model-visible packet/order/module-count/serialization correlates that predict D/E/Hyperposition targets while ignoring the intended canonical-state/evidence transition. Such a model can score well on in-family readout while failing causal re-entry and variable-N transfer.
counterhypothesis: Production ClayCode/Typed-Entry serialization is deliberately stable, so forcing invariance to every visible formatting feature may discard useful ABI signal and overconstrain a small model. Therefore nuisance removal should target factors that are not semantically authoritative for the label, while preserving explicitly role-typed ABI fields whose values are causally required.
